text:
kevin: Heads-up — support ticket from Acme: they saw ~40 tokens charged after a fallback. Stream resumed, output got truncated client-side, but ledger shows both provisional + finalized charges. wondering if we double-counted the replayed prefix on resume. attaching minimal logs.

kevin: ```
SESSION=acme-7f3
route: primary->fallback small-gpu@us-west2
stream: resumed at offset 128
ledger: provisional 128 tokens 
ledger: finalized 168 tokens
client: reported truncated at 160
```

sofia: can you paste the full session id and the request payload (no PII)?

kevin: session id above, payload is a short chat with a toolcall for /search; toolcall TTL was 2s in this case. no sensitive data.

maria: my hypothesis: when fallback triggers we create a provisional ledger entry for the chunk we already emitted, then on resume we replay prefix tokens to rebuild KV cache and ALSO emit partial tokens — if the replayed tokens are counted again as finalized we end up double-charging. toolcalls complicate this because TTL expiries can truncate the final output causing mismatched finalization windows.

jamal: telemetry: I see a 0.37% bump in provisional->finalize mismatch rate for us-west2 between 23:10-23:30 UTC that correlates with routing fallbacks. threw a quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_events WHERE provisional=true AND finalized_count>provisional_count AND region='us-west2' GROUP BY hour;`

eng-sre-bot: deploy INF-routing-v2 rolled out to canary at 23:05 UTC (ok).

product-ux: we should expose provisional vs finalized columns in the console's per-session view and show the routing handoff path (primary->fallback) in the timeline. Ops want quick refund button too.

billing: if this is reproducible we should auto-schedule a reconciliation job to detect finalized>provisional by >10 tokens and create credits. but want engineering to confirm root cause first.

sofia: quick idea: attach an idempotency tag at the request boundary and compute a prefix-hash for the first N tokens; server-side ledger finalize should dedupe any tokens where prefix-hash matches a prior provisional entry within the same session. that avoids relying on client ack ordering.

maria: careful — prefix-hash dedupe must account for KV-cache rebuilds that legitimately emit tokens during replay (they're part of final stream). maybe we only dedupe tokens attributed to the exact same model+route+offset window. add fallback_reason metadata to ledger.

jamal: I'll add trace spans in routing-service to include `chosen_model`, `fallback_reason`, and `last_ack_offset` so we can join traces -> ledger rows in analytics. will also emit a gauge `provisional_mismatch_rate` per-region.

kevin: plan I'm going to prototype: 1) add `fallback_reason` field in ledger rows, 2) on resume don't create a new provisional for replayed prefix if we detect a contiguous offset with an existing provisional, 3) add unit/integration test simulating reconnect+toolcall TTL.

product-ux: for rollout UX: gate ledger schema change behind a feature flag + expose a small canary toggle in console so SREs can opt in. also display provisional vs final breakdown on token billing dashboard.

billing: sounds good. also request an admin endpoint to issue credits for mismatch cases until auto-fix ships.

sofia: one more gotcha: toolcalls that get truncated still send webhook responses that we surface to customers — we need to ensure truncated toolcall tokens are treated consistently (either provisional-only or part of final), otherwise customers see inconsistent tool results vs charges.

maria: ack. I'll review the toolcall lifecycle. we might need a small change: when toolcall TTL expires mid-stream, mark the toolcall event as `truncated=true` and attach `charged_tokens` count. ledger finalize will consult that flag.

jamal: I'll add an analytic to surface sessions where `truncated=true` and `ledger_finalized_tokens != ledger_provisional_tokens` so product & billing can triage.

eng-sre-bot: created ticket INF-3247: "investigate provisional->finalized token delta on fallback/resume" and assigned to kevin, maria, jamal.

kevin: I'll open an RFC for the middleware dedupe and add the canary rollout plan. thanks all. :thumbsup:
